description: This file defines a singleton object PreferencesHelper that provides centralized access to UI-related preferences such as theme mode (dark mode) and display name. It encapsulates shared preferences management for these UI settings, including getter and setter methods, and applies theme changes using AppCompatDelegate.

classes.name: PreferencesHelper
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to access and modify UI preference settings such as theme mode and display name.

methods.name: prefs
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the SharedPreferences instance used for storing preferences.

methods.name: isDarkMode
methods.description: Returns whether dark mode is enabled based on shared preferences.

methods.name: setDarkMode
methods.description: Sets the dark mode preference and updates the app theme accordingly.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name from preferences, defaulting to 'Gokul' if not set.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Updates the display name in shared preferences.
